summary: EARTH Thunder 'scavengers.' Members activate straight from your hand to destroy a card, then swarm the board and loot the wreckage for more resources. Aggressive, hand-trap-resistant, and built to punish opponents who activate monster effects into it.

cards.name: Wisca Blitzclique
cards.effectText: If a card was destroyed by a “Blitzclique” effect this turn: reveal this card in your hand to Special Summon up to 3 Thunder monsters from your hand, then destroy that many cards on the field. Also, bounce a Thunder monster you control to negate and destroy an opponent's activated monster effect.

cards.name: Surge Blitzclique
cards.effectText: Reveal this card in your hand to target and destroy 1 card, then Special Summon 1 Thunder monster from your hand. On the field: when a card is destroyed by a card effect, add a “Blitzclique” monster from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Blitzclique – Breakaway
cards.effectText: Place 1 “Blitzclique” Continuous Trap from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone, or bounce 1 Thunder monster you control to destroy 1 card. Recurs itself from the GY.

cards.name: Blitzclique – Stepped Leader
cards.effectText: Add a Thunder monster from your GY to your hand off a destruction trigger. Can Special Summon a Thunder monster from your hand, then destroys itself.

cards.name: Blitzclique – Return Stroke
cards.effectText: Protects your Blitzclique monsters from opponent's card effects that would destroy them. Bounce a Blitzclique monster you control to negate and destroy an opponent's Spell activation. Banish this card from your GY to return a Blitzclique monster from GY to hand.

cards.name: Blitzclique – Alternator
cards.effectText: Your opponent's monsters lose 300 ATK/DEF for each Thunder monster you control. Shuffle a Blitzclique card you control back into the Deck to add a differently-named Thunder monster from your Deck to your hand.

comboLines.title: Turn 1 Breakaway loot loop (theorized starting point)
comboLines.body: Open Blitzclique – Breakaway to place Return Stroke face-up from the Deck. Reveal Surge Blitzclique from hand to destroy a card and Special Summon a Thunder monster, triggering Stepped Leader's GY recursion. Chain into Wisca Blitzclique once a Blitzclique effect has destroyed a card this turn to swarm 3 more Thunder monsters from hand. This is a community-theorized line, not a confirmed tournament combo — the set is only days old.
